title: Apportioning Tire Line for Shared Credits — Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty
content:
**Apportioning tire line — Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty.** Where a treadwear adjustment credit is shared between a workmanship share and the replacement ticket for the adjusted tire, the replacement ticket's tire line used to apportion the credit follows the set's age and the line's price basis:

1. **Set still within the line's free-replacement months** (whole calendar months from the purchase date fewer than 12, or fewer than 24 on the Crestline Ultra Touring 85K Treadwear Warranty line): the set's price per tire, like for like.
2. **Older set on a line prorated on the original price per tire** (the Crestline Value Touring 40K and All-Season 50K Treadwear Warranty lines): the lower of the selling price recorded on the set's latest treadwear adjustment and the price paid per tire on the set's ticket — the price per tire, less the set instant savings divided by the tire count when the ticket received it, less the fleet discount taken on the tires invoice posted for the vehicle on the purchase date divided by the tire count when the ticket was charged to a fleet account.
3. **Any other set:** the selling price recorded on the set's latest treadwear adjustment.

Free-replacement months by line, in line order: 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 24. Price basis by line: original price per tire on the 40K and 50K lines; current selling price on the 60K, 65K, 75K and 85K lines.

The fleet discount on a tires invoice is one percentage taken on every discountable line of the ticket, the tire price, the mounting and the valve-stem or TPMS-kit lines alike; wherever the tire price paid takes it off, the whole discount amount of that invoice is counted against the tire price, the part taken on the mounting and kit lines included, because those lines are never figured below the line's own charges here, and a ticket of an ordered set carries the tire price alone.

**Both sides of the age test (hypothetical set):** 11 whole months after purchase — the price per tire; 12 whole months on a 12-month line — rule 2 or 3 by price basis.
